title: The Chapel of Iron (Iron Downs) and the Pilgrims' Shrine (Coldpass) are near-identical reskins: porch/nave/crypt layout, an undead vigil-keeper resolved by rite/reading/force ('Saint Mora of the Vein' vs 'the frozen pilgrim'), and an identical crypt choice between 'lay them to rest' or take a reliquary, with matching flavor phrasing ('the ones the nave forgot').
where: Iron Downs — the Chapel of Iron; Coldpass — the Pilgrims' Shrine
